At 45, I have a consistent skincare routine, but I still felt like years of sun exposure and everyday life were leaving my skin looking a little “weathered.” I wasn’t expecting miracles, but this mask completely exceeded my expectations. I left it on for about 3 hours until it turned completely clear, and you could really tell it had absorbed into my skin. When I took it off, my skin looked incredibly smooth, firm, and hydrated. The best part? It felt dry to the touch—not greasy or sticky—but somehow still had the most youthful, dewy glow. I was so impressed that I didn’t wear makeup for the next five days because I was genuinely proud of how my skin looked. That’s something I never do! I’m still amazed by the results. This felt like a luxury spa treatment at home, and honestly, I’d gladly pay three times the price for the results I got. If you’re on the fence, give it a try—you may be just as surprised as I was!

avis.titre: Too much hype not enough honest help
avis.texte: So it is supposed to go on white and turn clear. It does that., it is supposed to make your skin look much better. For me not at all. I’m 65 and tried it after the ads all over Facebook and other places. Ads are wonderful. For me, right side of face looks like a burn and hurts from cheekbone to jawline. My skin is softer but if possible I look older and more tired. The bottom part wouldn’t stay on. For me, no glow maybe thankfully. Who wants a glow when your face hurts. The part on the left side of face feels softer so the moisturizer must be working there.

I was doubtful that this would do what it said but it really worked. I think my face must have been so dehydrated because I did not have a problem with this falling off like some others. It went on nicely and felt so good. I ended up falling asleep for about 4 hours. When I woke up the mask had completely turned clear and dried up. My face was so smooth and shiny when I took it off. It did bring some impurities to the top and I had a little breakout but nothing major. The breakout went away in about 2 days. Can’t wait to get the time to do the mask again for even smother skin.

I personally don’t think it does what they advertise. I do not see any change @ all. Yes it really does go clear after 1-2 hours yes while the mask is on it will start to tighten but do I look younger NO. Diminish wrinkles No bright shine looking skin no I still look tired. I’ve used 3 mask thus far & absolutely no change. However I did not experience the mask sliding off my face.
Not what I thought I was ordering. Does not fit face well and I have to cut them to lay flat.
Love it I can feel and see the hydration I will be purchasing again

These masks really hydrated mu skin. It comes into parts, the top half of your face and the bottom half. It mostly covered every area except it was difficult to get around the crows feet of both eyes. I had to do a lot of adjusting, and even then it wasn’t exact. I felt like the eyeholes were too big. I left mask on for hours. Most of the mask was clear except for a few patches here and there. I ended up taking off half the mask and leaving the rest. Results after 1 - were smooth feel and very hydrated skin. Not like the photos. Although very hydrated. I plan to use the entire multi pack and most likely will buy more as well
